the best results are obtained when we use tensor train decomposition with pruning and quantization for compression of recurrent neural network language models, and that the resulting model is 10 times faster than the original one while achieving a compression ratio of 20 times.

tensor train decomposition of the recurrent neural network language models can reduce their memory usage by up to 90% while preserving the same perplexity and increasing their inference speed by 2-5x, depending on the compression level.

(1) recurrent neural networks can be efficiently compressed for language modeling; (2) the best compression results are achieved by tensor train decomposition, which is a generalization of matrix decomposition to higher-order tensors, with compression rates of 1:10-1:30; (3) the compressed models are suitable for fast online inference, which is a key requirement in the context of mobile language modeling.
